deviations: The packet's closed form for a point on both planes paired the plane constants with the wrong normal brackets: p = (c0*(n1 - d*n0) + c1*(n0 - d*n1))/(1 - d^2) expands to p = ((c1 - c0*d)*n0 + (c0 - c1*d)*n1)/(1 - d^2), so p satisfies x.n0 = c1 and x.n1 = c0 instead of x.n0 = c0 and x.n1 = c1 (the packet explicitly asks to verify and fix it). Implemented the corrected pairing p = ((c0 - c1*d)*n0 + (c1 - c0*d)*n1)/(1 - d^2), derived from x.n0 = c0, x.n1 = c1 with d = n0.n1. Verified numerically (20k random unit-normal pairs) and by the on-both-carriers test: the added z=3 / y=5 transverse witness fails with the packet's form (residual 2.0 on both planes) and passes with the corrected one.
notes: Implemented vendor/truck/truck-evidence/src/analytic/plane_plane.rs: pub fn plane_plane(&Plane, &Plane) -> AnalyticOutcome using the shared crate::analytic::{AnalyticIntersection, ExactCurve} result type (no private result enum). Classification is decided by decisive inari interval predicates: normal cross product per component (any excludes_zero -> Curve(Line); all decisively_zero -> parallel branch), then the offset h = (o1-o0).n0 in intervals (decisively_zero -> Coincident, excludes_zero -> Parallel, else refuse). Undecidable predicates return Err(Refusal::NumericallyUnresolved { spent: Budget::new(0,0,0), witness: RootNotIsolated }). Every Ok carries the certificate field-by-field (props = {AnalyticCarrier: True}, Method::Exact, Budget::new(0,0,0), Margin::UNBOUNDED, Modulus::Unbounded); no certificate helper. The three_way comparator is defined exactly as specified but #[cfg(test)]-gated because the pre-decided algorithm never calls it, so a lib build would otherwise trip clippy's dead_code under -D warnings; decisively_zero/excludes_zero are production helpers. Method::Exact is documented on the function: exact classification by decisive interval predicates on f64 carrier parameters, closed-form line, f64 coordinates with machine-precision on-both-carriers obligation, no tau_rep. All 6 anchors pass (1 each). Added exactly the 5 required tests: pp_transverse_line_lies_on_both_planes (z=0/y=0 through origin, the packet's generic pair through the origin, and a nonzero-offset z=3/y=5 pair; 64 samples each, H-3-commented plane-residual and unit-direction slacks), pp_parallel_and_coincident_classify_exactly, pp_coincident_through_different_point_triples (both argument orders), pp_undecidable_predicates_refuse (bit-level straddle witness not constructible for plane normals; covers the refusal path directly on hand-built intervals and three_way None), pp_certificate_is_exact (transverse/parallel/coincident: Method::Exact, AnalyticCarrier True, all other Prop variants Unknown).
